title: Compare EC50 models
text: examples use small subset multi_isolate vignette runs quickly still showing grouped workflow. Inspect raw dose-response observations comparing models. isolate can repeated observations dose, plot uses jittered points instead connecting observations lines.
code: data(multi_isolate)  example_data <- subset(   multi_isolate,   isolate %in% 1:5 & fungicida == "Fungicide A" )  head(example_data) ##   isolate   field   fungicida  dose     growth ## 1       1 Organic Fungicide A 0e+00 20.2082399 ## 2       1 Organic Fungicide A 1e-05 20.1168279 ## 3       1 Organic Fungicide A 1e-04 19.2479678 ## 4       1 Organic Fungicide A 1e-03 15.8123455 ## 5       1 Organic Fungicide A 1e-02  7.3206757 ## 6       1 Organic Fungicide A 1e-01  0.6985264 ggplot(example_data, aes(dose, growth, color = factor(isolate))) +   geom_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0, alpha = 0.85, size = 2) +   facet_wrap(~field) +   scale_x_log10() +   labs(x = "Dose", y = "Growth", color = "Isolate") +   theme_light() ## Warning in scale_x_log10(): log-10 transformation introduced ## infinite values.

title: Compare EC50 models
text: Pass list candidate model functions fct. function fits model isolate stratum, appends model-selection statistics returned drc::mselect(). model column identifies candidate model. IC column information criterion reported drc::mselect() fitted model.

title: Compare EC50 models
text: can rank candidate models within isolate stratum using base R. Lower IC values indicate stronger relative support among compared models.
code: ranked_models <- df_models[order(df_models$field, df_models$ID, df_models$IC), ] best_models <- ranked_models[!duplicated(ranked_models[c("field", "ID")]), ]  best_models[, c("ID", "field", "model", "Estimate", "Std..Error", "IC")] ##     ID        field model    Estimate   Std..Error       IC ## 36   2 Conventional  LL.3 0.101455765 0.0076364691 95.06365 ## 106  4 Conventional  LL.3 0.079971237 0.0055655891 84.84309 ## 1    1      Organic  LL.3 0.006072082 0.0005740341 98.30158 ## 712  3      Organic  W2.3 0.003233688 0.0001397399 76.96774 ## 141  5      Organic  LL.3 0.006122508 0.0004575060 90.82115

title: Compare EC50 models
text: Plot information criterion across isolates see whether one model consistently preferred.  choosing appropriate model, use estimate_EC50() final estimation workflow single model applied across full dataset.
code: plot_models <- df_models plot_models$ID <- as.numeric(plot_models$ID)  ggplot(plot_models, aes(ID, IC, color = model)) +   geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.35), size = 2) +   facet_wrap(~field) +   scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(plot_models$ID))) +   labs(x = "Isolate", y = "Information criterion") +   theme_light()

title: Estimate EC50 with one model
text: Use estimate_EC50() already know dose-response model fitted isolate. function runs drc model across isolates optional strata, returns single data frame EC estimates.

title: Estimate EC50 with one model
text: package includes multi_isolate, simulated dataset mycelial growth increasing fungicide doses 50 fungal isolates, two field systems, two fungicides. Inspect raw dose-response data fitting models.
code: data(multi_isolate) head(multi_isolate) ##   isolate   field   fungicida  dose     growth ## 1       1 Organic Fungicide A 0e+00 20.2082399 ## 2       1 Organic Fungicide A 1e-05 20.1168279 ## 3       1 Organic Fungicide A 1e-04 19.2479678 ## 4       1 Organic Fungicide A 1e-03 15.8123455 ## 5       1 Organic Fungicide A 1e-02  7.3206757 ## 6       1 Organic Fungicide A 1e-01  0.6985264 ggplot(multi_isolate, aes(dose, growth, color = growth)) +   geom_jitter(width = 0.1) +   facet_grid(field ~ fungicida) +   scale_x_log10() +   scale_color_viridis_c(option = "B", direction = 1) +   theme_light() ## Warning in scale_x_log10(): log-10 transformation introduced ## infinite values.

title: Estimate EC50 with one model
text: estimate_EC50() needs model ingredients pass drc::drm(): formula, data frame, model function drc::LL.3(). Use isolate_col identify isolates strata_col grouping columns field, fungicide, year, location. result keeps isolate identifier ID, returns strata columns effective-dose estimate columns drc::ED().
code: df_ec50 <- estimate_EC50(   growth ~ dose,   data = multi_isolate,   isolate_col = "isolate",   strata_col = c("field", "fungicida"),   interval = "delta",   fct = drc::LL.3() )  head(df_ec50) ##      ID        field   fungicida    Estimate   Std..Error       Lower ## 1     1      Organic Fungicide A 0.006072082 0.0005740341 0.004902813 ## 1751  1      Organic Fungicide B 0.006072082 0.0005740341 0.004902813 ## 36    2 Conventional Fungicide A 0.101455765 0.0076364691 0.085900787 ## 1786  2 Conventional Fungicide B 0.005297468 0.0005233600 0.004231418 ## 71    3      Organic Fungicide A 0.003776957 0.0002432571 0.003281459 ## 1821  3      Organic Fungicide B 0.003776957 0.0002432571 0.003281459 ##            Upper ## 1    0.007241351 ## 1751 0.007241351 ## 36   0.117010744 ## 1786 0.006363517 ## 71   0.004272456 ## 1821 0.004272456

title: Estimate EC50 with one model
text: Plot EC50 estimates confidence intervals isolates.  Density plots can help compare EC50 distributions strata.
code: plot_ec50 <- df_ec50 plot_ec50$ID <- as.numeric(plot_ec50$ID)  ggplot(plot_ec50, aes(ID, Estimate, color = field)) +   geom_point(size = 2) +   geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper, color = field), width = 0) +   facet_wrap(~fungicida, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +   scale_y_log10() +   scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:50) +   scale_color_manual(values = c("darkred", "steelblue")) +   labs(x = "Isolates", y = "EC50") +   theme_minimal_vgrid(font_size = 10) +   coord_flip() +   theme(     axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),     legend.position = "bottom"   ) ggplot(df_ec50, aes(Estimate, field, fill = after_stat(x))) +   geom_density_ridges_gradient(alpha = 0.3) +   scale_x_log10() +   scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C") +   facet_wrap(~fungicida, nrow = 2) +   theme_minimal_hgrid() +   labs(x = "EC50", y = "Field") +   theme(legend.position = "none") ## Picking joint bandwidth of 0.0328 ## Picking joint bandwidth of 0.0285

title: An Automated Way to Estimate EC50 for Stratified Datasets
text: ec50estimator provides quick, automated way estimate effective concentration reduces growth 50% (EC50) multi-isolate dose-response datasets. designed scientists need simple workflow grouped stratified experiments still using modelling engine drc. package now keeps runtime dependencies intentionally small: drc imported package.

title: An Automated Way to Estimate EC50 for Stratified Datasets
text: Install stable release CRAN. development version can download using following code:

title: An Automated Way to Estimate EC50 for Stratified Datasets
code: library(ec50estimator)  data(multi_isolate)  ec50 <- estimate_EC50(   growth ~ dose,   data = multi_isolate,   isolate_col = "isolate",   strata_col = c("field", "fungicida"),   fct = drc::LL.3(),   interval = "delta" )  head(ec50)

what: Estimate effective doses for grouped dose-response data — estimate_EC50
title: Estimate effective doses for grouped dose-response data — estimate_EC50
text: `estimate_EC50()` fits one dose-response model per isolate, optionally within strata year, site, treatment, fungicide. `ec50_multimodel()` repeats workflow several `drc` model functions returns model-selection statistics estimates.

title: Estimate effective doses for grouped dose-response data — estimate_EC50
code: estimate_EC50(   formula,   data,   EC_lvl = 50,   isolate_col,   strata_col = NULL,   fct,   interval = c("none", "delta", "fls", "tfls"),   type = c("relative", "absolute"),   quiet = FALSE )  ec50_multimodel(   formula,   data,   EC_lvl = 50,   isolate_col,   strata_col = NULL,   fct,   interval = c("none", "delta", "fls", "tfls"),   type = c("relative", "absolute"),   quiet = FALSE )

title: Estimate effective doses for grouped dose-response data — estimate_EC50
text: formula two-sided formula passed [drc::drm()], example `growth ~ dose`. data data frame containing response, dose, isolate, optional stratification columns. EC_lvl Numeric effective-dose level(s) passed [drc::ED()]. default estimates EC50. isolate_col Character scalar naming column identifies isolate. strata_col Optional character vector naming columns used split data fitting models. fct `drc` model function object `drc::LL.3()` `estimate_EC50()`. `ec50_multimodel()`, provide list `list(drc::LL.3(), drc::LL.4())`. interval Character scalar passed [drc::ED()]. One `"none"`, `"delta"`, `"fls"`, `"tfls"`. type Character scalar passed [drc::ED()]. One `"relative"` `"absolute"`. quiet Logical. `FALSE`, failed isolate/model fits reported warning.

title: Estimate effective doses for grouped dose-response data — estimate_EC50
text: data frame one row per successful estimate. first columns   identify isolate (`ID`) strata, followed columns returned   [drc::ED()]. `ec50_multimodel()` also appends model-selection statistics   [drc::mselect()] `model` column.

title: Plot fitted dose-response curves for multiple isolates — plot_EC50_curves
text: formula two-sided formula passed [drc::drm()], example `growth ~ dose`. plotting helper supports exactly one predictor right-hand side. data data frame containing response, dose, isolate, optional stratification columns. isolate_col Character scalar naming column identifies isolate. strata_col Optional character vector naming columns used split data fitting models. fct `drc` model function object `drc::LL.3()`, list model function objects `list(drc::LL.3(), drc::LL.4())`. color_col Character scalar naming column mapped curve point color. Defaults `isolate_col`. facet_col, facet_row Optional character scalars naming columns used faceting. omitted, first two `strata_col` values used. n_points Number dose values used draw fitted curve. log_x Logical. `TRUE`, use log10 x-axis omit non-positive dose values plotted data prediction grid. point_size, point_alpha Size alpha raw observation points. line_width Width fitted curves. quiet Logical. `FALSE`, failed group/model fits reported warning.

title: ec50estimator 1.0.0
text: Added plot_EC50_curves() plotting raw dose-response observations fitted drc curves across isolates, strata, one candidate models. Modernized EC50 estimation internals shared validation, clearer errors, warnings failed isolate-level fits. Reduced imported dependencies drc. Added support type = "relative" type = "absolute" estimate_EC50(). Added automated tests grouped estimates, argument validation, absolute effective-dose levels, multimodel output. Converted example dataset standard package data format. Refreshed vignette, README, pkgdown configuration.
